sourcedFrom: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. (UNDATED)
cleanIntro: The G2C comes apart on a disassembly latch and ⛔ its published strip REQUIRES A TRIGGER PULL — step 3 is "Pull and release trigger. Then remove the slide from the grip." That is why the five-point unload check in step 1 is not a formality: it is the only thing standing between the procedure and a discharge. Taurus asks for eye protection throughout, and for a clean every 200 rounds.

steps.title: ⛔ Five checks before anything moves — and eye protection on
steps.action: Finger off the trigger and on the memory pad, muzzle in a safe direction, magazine out, slide locked back, and then LOOK AND FEEL the magazine well and chamber. Taurus lists all five as one step because the strip that follows pulls the trigger. Eye protection rated ANSI Z87.1+ goes on for the whole job.
steps.aside: After removing the magazine, always check the chamber and make sure it is empty.
steps.quote: Always wear eye protection that is specified for use with firearms (ANSI Z87.1+) every time you handle your firearm for cleaning and maintenance.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.30-31

steps.title: Four fingers over the slide, draw back 1/8", latch DOWN
steps.action: Hold the pistol with four fingers over the slide and your thumb on the rear of the grip, draw the slide back about an eighth of an inch, and pull the disassembly latch DOWN with the other hand. Then release the slide, then release the latch — in that order.
steps.quote: Using the fingers draw back the slide about 1/8”. With the other hand pull disassembly latch down. Release slide. Release disassembly latch.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.30-31

steps.title: ⛔ Pull and release the trigger, THEN the slide comes off
steps.action: This is the step that makes the unload check load-bearing. With the muzzle in a safe direction, pull and release the trigger — then run the slide off the front of the grip. ⚠ The PT 111 Millennium G2, this pistol's ancestor, does NOT have this step; do not carry one procedure onto the other.
steps.quote: Pull and release trigger. Then remove the slide from the grip.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.30-31

steps.title: ⛔ Recoil spring is compressed — ease it off the barrel
steps.action: Release the recoil spring assembly from its seat on the underside of the barrel, controlling it as it comes. Taurus warns specifically about the slide spring assembly plate and the compressed spring being forcibly ejected — that is a part leaving at speed toward your face.
steps.aside: Release recoil spring assembly from its position on the bottom of the barrel.
steps.quote: Please take care to prevent the forcible ejection of the slide spring assembly plate and compressed slide spring assembly.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.30-31

steps.title: Barrel forward and up — strip complete
steps.action: Take the barrel out of the slide by pulling it forward and then up. Frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly and magazine: that is the whole field strip.
steps.quote: Remove the barrel from the slide by pulling it to the front and up.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.30-31

steps.title: Bore: brass brush in solvent, then a dry patch
steps.action: Take the heavy firing residue out of the bore and chamber with a properly fitted BRASS brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent, then finish by running a dry cotton patch through to carry out what the solvent loosened. The bore is left free of debris, not merely wiped.
steps.aside: Finish the bore cleaning process by running a dry cotton cloth patch through the bore to remove remaining residue and solvent.
steps.quote: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber using a properly fitted brass brush dipped in a gun cleaning solvent.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CARE AND MAINTENANCE, printed p.34

steps.title: Exterior, slide and rails — small brush for the crevices
steps.action: Non-abrasive cloth over the exterior, the slide and the rails, and a small brush into the crevices where dust and residue collect. Then lubricate the two places Taurus names: the frame rails and the barrel lockup points.
steps.aside: Lubricate the frame rails and barrel lockup points
steps.quote: Clean the exterior of the firearm, slide and rails using a non abrasive cleaning cloth.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CARE AND MAINTENANCE, printed p.34

steps.title: ⛔ Every 200 rounds — and check the screws while you are there
steps.action: Taurus's interval is 200 rounds, and it attaches a second job to it: at the same time, check for loose screws or pins, tighten what has come loose and press pins back in. Finish by rubbing the pistol with a lightly oiled cloth — a light film everywhere is what stops corrosion.
steps.aside: After cleaning, rub the pistol with a lightly oiled cloth.
steps.quote: At the same time check for any lose screws or pins. Tighten the screws and press pins back in as needed.
steps.cite: Taurus G2C/G2S Instruction Manual — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CARE AND MAINTENANCE, printed p.34

deepAbsentReason: Taurus publishes nothing past this field strip for a G2C owner — the disassembly chapter ends with the barrel out and the next heading is Assembly. ⚠ The book does publish a MAGAZINE disassembly (a punch on the magazine spring seat), which is a magazine procedure rather than a deeper strip of the pistol, and it is not authored as a deep clean. Nothing deeper is borrowed from another source.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Brass brush dipped in gun solvent for the heavy residue
Dry cotton patch through to finish — bore left free of debris

cleaning.name: SLIDE, RAILS & EXTERIOR
tasks: Non-abrasive cloth over exterior, slide and rails
Small brush into the crevices for dust and residue

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: Frame rails and barrel lockup points
Light film of good gun oil everywhere, applied with a cloth
⛔ A laser-equipped pistol is never submerged or ultrasonically cleaned

cleaning.name: EVERY 200 ROUNDS
tasks: Check for loose screws and pins and set them right

reassembly: Barrel into the slide, entered from the front and lowered into place.
Recoil spring assembly compressed slightly and seated onto the underside of the barrel.
Slide onto the frame rails and run fully to the rear.
⛔ Disassembly latch returned to its up position before the slide is released.
Cycle the slide several times with no magazine and no round in the chamber, then function check.
fncheck: Reassembled and unloaded: cycle the slide several times with no magazine and an empty chamber and confirm it returns fully into battery, then check the disassembly latch has returned to its up position. Confirm the slide locks back on an empty magazine. ⛔ A pistol that will not go fully into battery has the recoil spring assembly seated wrongly — take it apart again rather than forcing it.
